references.text: Continuation of the procedure after the seven days of isolation, describing what the priest shall do at the next examination.
The same procedure with seven days of isolation is used when examining boils that may be leprosy.
A corresponding procedure with seven days of isolation for examining burns.
The same pattern with seven days of isolation is used when examining scaly sores on the head or beard.
The priest uses the same seven-day isolation procedure when examining leprosy in garments.
A seven-day isolation procedure is also used when examining leprosy in houses.
Miriam was shut out from the camp for seven days because of leprosy, illustrating the practical application of the law of isolation.
